items.html: And the Daat, called HG: the two halves of the Daat were first the two shoulders of AA, and from there they were drawn to the two crowns of the Yesods of AVI, which are the Gevurot of Aba and of Ima, and from there they were drawn to be two crowns in the Daat of ZA, as mentioned in the Idra Rabba and the Idra Zuta. And the two Mochin themselves, which are KHB, are drawn from two Mochin, from the very brain of AVI, and from there they are drawn to their two Yesods: Hochma in the Yesod of Aba, Bina in the Yesod of Ima. And the two crowns, which were first the two shoulders of AA, were drawn into the two crowns of the above-mentioned Yesods of AVI: the Hassadim in the crown of the Yesod of Aba, and the Gevurot in the crown of the Yesod of Ima.
